T0585.title: WAF Rule
T0585.definition: A web application firewall rule used to detect, block, challenge, or log suspicious HTTP traffic.
T0585.description: WAF rules detect and handle suspicious HTTP requests, but broad rules can break business flows and narrow rules can be bypassed. Effective operations combine threat intelligence, business context, exception management, staged rollout, and hit-quality review instead of relying indefinitely on static rules.
T0585.usageExample: Assess WAF Rule related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
